related_questions.question: Do UK citizens need a visa for the USA?

text_blocks.snippet: No, UK citizens do not need a traditional visa for short stays in the USA. They can travel under the Visa Waiver Program (VWP), which allows stays of up to 90 days for tourism or business purposes. However, they do need to apply for ESTA (Electronic System for Travel Authorization) approval before traveling.

list.title: ESTA Requirement:

list.title: ESTA Application:
list.snippet: The ESTA application is completed online and requires providing personal information, passport details, and answering questions about eligibility.

list.title: ESTA Validity:
list.snippet: Once approved, an ESTA is typically valid for two years for multiple entries, allowing stays of up to 90 days per visit.

list.title: Visa for Longer Stays:
list.snippet: If a UK citizen plans to stay in the US for longer than 90 days or for purposes other than tourism or business (e.g., work or study), they will need to apply for a specific US visa.
